regime: Morning selloff that reversed: tech and metals fell hard, then recovered most losses by the close
takeaway: Hot core inflation and a tariff report sent the Nasdaq down as much as 4.6% and gold to a 15-month low near $3,446 in the morning, but both recovered: the Nasdaq closed down only 0.6% and gold finished up about 0.9%, with miners up 3.5% to 4% and the VIX still higher at 28.3. Bonds rallied, with the 10-year yield down about 6 bp to 4.85%, which fits the bonds-rallying pattern, while the yen was flat, so there is no sign of a carry unwind. Silver ended slightly higher but the gold/silver ratio stayed high near 87, so the silver-under-stress check still applies.
